
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(coin)
library(knitr)
library(kableExtra)
```

```{r}
df_raw <- read_csv("./Processed Data/survey_aq_data.csv") |>
  mutate(Score_mod = case_when(
    QuestionID %in% c('Q01','Q02','Q03','Q04','Q05','Q06','Q07','Q08') &
      HouseID == "H29" & Survey == "Post_Intervention" ~ NA,
    TRUE ~ Score_mod
  ))

fa_df <- df_raw %>%
  select(HouseID, Survey, QuestionID, Score_mod) %>%
  filter(QuestionID %in% paste0("Q", sprintf("%02d", 9:22))) %>%
  pivot_wider(id_cols = c(HouseID, Survey), names_from = QuestionID, values_from = Score_mod) %>%
  filter(HouseID != "H29")

fa_df_imputed <- kNN(fa_df %>% dplyr::select(-c(HouseID, Survey))) %>%
  select(1:(ncol(fa_df)-2)) %>%
  mutate(HouseID = fa_df$HouseID,
         Survey = fa_df$Survey)

groups <- df_raw %>%
  filter(!QuestionID %in% c("Q23", "Q24")) %>% # duplicate quesitons
  select(QuestionID, Construct) %>%
  distinct(.keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  group_by(Construct) %>%
  summarize(QuestionIDs = list(QuestionID)) %>%
  ungroup()

sevo3_qs <- groups %>% filter(Construct == "Perceived Severity (O3)") %>% pull(QuestionIDs)
sevpm_qs <- groups %>% filter(Construct == "Perceived Severity (PM2.5)") %>% pull(QuestionIDs)
suso3_qs <- groups %>% filter(Construct == "Perceived Susceptibility (O3)") %>% pull(QuestionIDs)
suspm_qs <- groups %>% filter(Construct == "Perceived Susceptibility (PM2.5)") %>%
  pull(QuestionIDs)
```

General Score:
```{r}
test1_df <- fa_df_imputed %>% 
  mutate(total_score =  rowSums(across(Q09:Q22))) %>%
  select(HouseID, Survey, total_score) %>%
  pivot_wider(id_cols = HouseID, names_from = Survey, values_from = total_score) %>%
  mutate(difference = Post_Intervention - Pre_Intervention)

differences <- test1_df$difference
```

This next function takes get_score_analysis and changes it to be able to run the wilcoxon test, and also adding adjusted P-values and unadjusted p-values. Also using Holme Testing
```{r}
wilcoxon_score_analysis <- function(qs, construct_name) {

  total_possible <- length(qs)*5

  test2_df <- fa_df_imputed %>%
    select(HouseID, Survey, all_of(qs)) %>%
    mutate(total_score = rowSums(across(all_of(qs)))) %>%
    select(HouseID, Survey, total_score) %>%
    pivot_wider(id_cols = HouseID,
                names_from = Survey,
                values_from = total_score) %>%
    mutate(Post_Intervention = Post_Intervention/total_possible,
           Pre_Intervention = Pre_Intervention/total_possible,
      difference = Post_Intervention - Pre_Intervention)

  # wilcoxsign_test is coin's paired (signed-rank) test: it takes the two
  # paired columns directly, no long-format value/group reshaping needed.
  test <- wilcoxsign_test(Post_Intervention ~ Pre_Intervention,
                           data = test2_df,
                           distribution = "exact")

  # conf.int = TRUE requires a coin version that supports it for
  # wilcoxsign_test; fall back to base wilcox.test's Hodges-Lehmann CI
  # (same estimand) if the installed coin version doesn't support it.
  ci_est <- tryCatch({
    test_ci <- wilcoxsign_test(Post_Intervention ~ Pre_Intervention,
                                data = test2_df,
                                distribution = "exact",
                                conf.int = TRUE)
    ci_out <- confint(test_ci)
    list(estimate = unname(ci_out$estimate), ci = ci_out$conf.int)
  }, error = function(e) {
    wt <- wilcox.test(test2_df$Post_Intervention, test2_df$Pre_Intervention,
                       paired = TRUE, conf.int = TRUE, exact = TRUE)
    list(estimate = unname(wt$estimate), ci = wt$conf.int)
  })

  # coin test objects are S4 - use statistic()/pvalue(), not $statistic/$p.value.
  list(
    Construct = construct_name,
    data = test2_df,
    n = sum(!is.na(test2_df$difference)),
    pre_score = mean(test2_df$Pre_Intervention),
    post_score = mean(test2_df$Post_Intervention),
    z_stat = coin::statistic(test),
    p_value = coin::pvalue(test),
    median_diff = median(test2_df$difference, na.rm = TRUE),
    estimate = ci_est$estimate,
    ci = ci_est$ci
  )
}

construct_qs <- list(
  "Perceived Severity (O3)" = sevo3_qs[[1]],
  "Perceived Susceptibility (O3)" = suso3_qs[[1]],
  "Perceived Threat (O3)" = c(sevo3_qs[[1]], suso3_qs[[1]]),
  "Perceived Severity (PM2.5)" = sevpm_qs[[1]],
  "Perceived Susceptibility (PM2.5)" = suspm_qs[[1]],
  "Perceived Threat (PM2.5)" = c(sevpm_qs[[1]], suspm_qs[[1]])
)

results <- lapply(names(construct_qs), function(con) {
  wilcoxon_score_analysis(construct_qs[[con]], con)
})

raw_p <- sapply(results, function(x) x$p_value)

# Holm correction applied separately within each pollutant, not across all 6
# constructs together - ave() splits raw_p by pollutant, runs p.adjust on
# each subset, then recombines in the original construct order.
pollutant <- case_when(
  str_detect(sapply(results, function(x) x$Construct), "O3") ~ "O3",
  str_detect(sapply(results, function(x) x$Construct), "PM2.5") ~ "PM2.5",
  TRUE ~ NA_character_
)
adj_p <- ave(raw_p, pollutant, FUN = function(p) p.adjust(p, method = "holm"))

summary_table <- bind_rows(lapply(seq_along(results), function(i) {
  x <- results[[i]]
  data.frame(
    Construct = x$Construct,
    N = x$n,
    `Pre Survey Score` = round(x$pre_score, 2),
    `Post Survey Score` = round(x$post_score, 2),
    `Median Difference` = round(x$median_diff, 2),
    `Hodges-Lehmann Estimate` = round(x$estimate, 2),
    `Z-stat` = round(x$z_stat, 2),
    `P-value` = round(raw_p[i], 3),
    `Adj. P-value` = round(adj_p[i], 3),
    `95% CI` = paste0("(", round(x$ci[1], 2), ", ", round(x$ci[2], 2), ")"),
    Pollutant = pollutant[i],
    check.names = FALSE
  )
}))

summary_table <- summary_table %>%
  arrange(Pollutant, Construct)

write_csv(summary_table |> select(-Pollutant),'./Processed Data/wilcox_diff_risk_constructs.csv')

# pack_rows needs consecutive run-lengths per group, in the order rows
# appear after arrange() above (O3 rows first, then PM2.5 rows)
group_index <- rle(summary_table$Pollutant)
group_index <- setNames(group_index$lengths, group_index$values)

tbl_grouped <- summary_table %>%
  select(-Pollutant) %>%
  kable(row.names = FALSE,
        booktabs = TRUE,
        caption = "Wilcoxon Signed-Rank Tests by Pollutant and Construct") %>%
  kable_styling(latex_options = "hold_position", font_size = 9, full_width = FALSE) %>%
  pack_rows(index = group_index)

tbl_grouped
```
